question: Is a one-time rebuild of the Codex, Claude, Vertex AI, and Pi cost caches acceptable to discard offsets created by the old EOF behavior?
rationale: The implementation can invalidate every potentially affected artifact, but owner intent is needed to confirm that the upgrade-time rescan cost across all providers is an acceptable compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Approve broad rebuild
options.body: Accept the one-time rescan for all four cache namespaces because each may contain offsets committed past an incomplete EOF record.

options.title: Narrow invalidation
options.body: Require evidence identifying only the provider caches that can contain affected offsets, then bump only those artifact versions.

recommendation.title: Approve broad rebuild
recommendation.body: Accept the one-time rescan for all four cache namespaces because each may contain offsets committed past an incomplete EOF record.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the closest merged scanner-performance work and is best positioned to assess scanner correctness against rescan cost.
